notes.title: Changes incoming!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Progress on the next update is well underway, however It's going to take a bit of time, here is why.

[b]Current state of the game[/b]

The game is currently in the Alpha stage of its development, these updates are quick, and were meant to get a feel for the game and mechanics. 

Over the next two updates the game will transition to beta, which it will remain in for quite some time, these updates will take significantly longer, each update will require more polish and work. 

This is why version 9 of the alpha will take longer than the rest, and because it is two patches merged into one. 

While developing version 9, the mechanics being developed would mostly be utilized by the next patch to come after it, and it just made more sense to combine the two patches. 

Oh, I should mention this will break saves again sorry!

[b]Pricing[/b]

The plan has always been to increase the game price, up to a maximum, when new content comes out that justifies its new cost, you should pay what the game is currently worth, not what it will be worth!

That being said... the current price is $4.99 which is going to increase to $7.99.
(The price change won't occur till after the next update launches!)

[b]Multi-Language support[/b]

Just a quick note, the next update will include the option to change the game to a different language, although this will be machine translated, it should open the game up to more people, leave a comment of any languages you would like to use or see in the game.


I hope you are as excited as I am to see the future of Ruin!

notes.title: Update for Ruin - Alpha (V8)
notes.notes:
This small update adds player models to the game. 
The models are work in progress, and so is the animations, you can expect more animations and updates to the graphics in later updates. 

The next update will be primarily focused on gameplay. 

Some other changes this update:
[list]

[*] Added some lines of code so the camera should no longer be able to go into objects
[*] Changed how much you can zoom in, so you can see your characters better!
[*] Improved the lighting on some objects and items!
[*] Some code improvements, but need to do a full recode of some stuff. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update for Ruin - Alpha (V0.0.6.1)
notes.notes:
This small update is meant to address small issues.

[list]
[*] New hint of whats to come on new game screen :)
[*] "F" Key will bring the camera to current highlighted unit (Can be held)
[*] New model for the skeletons.
[*] Changed the setting menu background to a solid colour instead of transparent.
[*] Slightly increased zoom in distance.
[*] Rewrote the interaction code for work stations (eg. Furnace, Crafting table)
[/list]

[list]
[*] Reduced the camera move speed.
[*] Reduced the camera zoomed in speed slightly.
[*] Reduced the camera rotation speed.
[*] Updated the tooltip
[*] Disabled unused buttons on the header interface.
[*] Fixed a bug where units would harvest resources too quickly.
[/list]

The next update will take some time so please be patient!
Thank you for your support!
